evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 丛芳榭
evidence.excerpt_zh: 平疇交逺風之東為叢芳榭後為琴清齋（長春園册）臣等謹案琴清齋内額曰霞蹤天想
evidence.summary: East of 平疇交逺風: 叢芳榭 and 琴清齋 behind it.

evidence.title: 琴清斋
evidence.locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 6-695
evidence.excerpt_zh: 髙斋枕碧川，琴清名有年。徒观澄止水，未听鸣响泉。却讶渊明室，别体蓄无弦。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 琴清斋
evidence.locator: v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 8-763
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书斋临水号琴清，正是春温和且平。何必七弦虞拨剌，由来太古自然声。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 琴清斋口号
evidence.locator: v3 p.407, under 狮子林; source ref 18-619
evidence.excerpt_zh: 远瀑漫寻七弦比，近湖恒对五音清。那更陶壁相唐突，个里无声却有声。
evidence.summary: Poem 琴清斋口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1793, filed by the editors under 狮子林.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 狮子林
evidence.summary: Two gardens: 丛芳榭 of 1747 (five-bay hall on the lake, 琴清斋 behind, 漾月 and 集虚 pavilions), and from 1772 the Suzhou copy to its north-east. It lists the sixteen scenes, and says Qianlong's copy of Ni Zan's painting was kept in 清閟阁. Partly rebuilt 1828.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 琴清斋, 2x1 cells.
